why: Counts every declared property instead of only the ones whose value changes, which is the subtlety that makes this sweep work. Every `--still` set declares `transform: none` at each step -- that is what makes it the reduced variant -- so a property-NAME check reads the cancelled movement as a second channel. Measured both ways on the tree before the fix: by name, 0 offenders across all nine sets; by varying value, exactly 1, and it was the one the stylesheet already admitted to.
killedBy: hud.css: no reduced-motion cue is carried by colour alone (issue #924) rings the life counter, which is the channel that survives forced colours and greyscale
